messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Pool gpu-hot-warm-us-east experiencing sustained queue growth and autoscaler failures -> placement errors above threshold. Queue=1400, throttled=7%.
Priya S: i'm up. what are the top symptoms?
Diego M: scheduler logs show repeated 'NoFit' with reason: `mismatch: requested mig=1g, available slices fragmented across nodes (1x8g, 4x2g, 6x1g)`. large number of nodes with partially used slices.
infra-elyse: autoscaler tried to add nodes but cloud provider returned `QuotaExceeded` for additional 1g-profile GPU SKUs. autoscaler then retried with same template and failed.
oncall-ron: taking over from Priya. ron here. Priya please handoff.
Priya S: handoff: queue spiked from 300 -> 1400 over 22m, tail latency > 8s for real-time routes, several customers intermittently 503. many nodes show GPU utilization 0-5% and others >90%. housing of tiny requests scattered causing fragmentation.
cs-maya: pushed initial customer comms to impacted list (acct-118, acct-777) — they are seeing timeouts. will send CRTs.
QA-nate: i can throttle synthetic load if you need to create headroom while we fix.
Priya S: yes please reduce synthetic traffic and route non-critical requests to fallback model. scheduler-bot: enabling route fallback to small-model-bank for 15m.
scheduler-bot: executed: route-policy set inference/rt -> fallback-model-small for traffic fraction 0.35
Diego M: short-term mitigation options: 1) enable scheduler "flex-slice" that allows pods to consume multiple 1g slices on same node (requires binding change), 2) instruct autoscaler to prefer 8g nodes and then allow placing many 1g pods on them, 3) run targeted eviction of batch pods to defragment.
infra-elyse: cloud quota prevents adding many 1g nodes but we have capacity for 8g flavor. i can tweak node template to spawn 8g nodes but need approval.
oncall-ron: approve the 8g node template change, but first do batch eviction to free contiguous slices where possible. Diego coordinate evictions so we don't disrupt high-priority jobs.
Diego M: running eviction for label `preemptible=batch` in namespace inference: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n inference -l preemptible=batch -o name | xargs -r -n1 kubectl delete -n inference --grace-period=20
```
ops-bot: eviction observed: 48 pods terminated.
infra-elyse: updating autoscaler template to prefer 8g sku: `infractl pools update gpu-hot-warm-us-east --node-gpu=8g --max=80`
ops-bot: autoscaler update accepted, launching 5 nodes (0/5 ready).
Priya S: also temporarily disable scale-down to avoid churn while new nodes join: `redwoodctl autoscaler set --pool gpu-hot-warm-us-east --scale-down-enabled=false`
QA-nate: reduced synthetic load by 60%. seeing queue drop slowly.
Diego M: scheduler feature flag toggle: `runtime.scheduling.allow_multi_slice_bind=true` applied to control plane for 30m window. will monitor for correctness.
Priya S: watch for isolation regressions — multi-slice binding can land multiple pods on same physical GPU and may violate tenant isolation SLAs for dedicated contracts. mark high-risk.
cs-maya: customers notified of mitigation plan, ETA for stabilization ~1h. they requested status updates every 30m.
incident-bot: attached logs: /logs/incidents/1995558888/autoscaler.log and /logs/incidents/1995558888/scheduler.log
ops-bot: new nodes registering (3/5 ready). pending pods scheduling onto 8g nodes now. queue 1400 -> 650.
Diego M: placement improved after 2 nodes up. however we still have ~10 nodes with stranded slices due to label mismatch (legacy label `mig_cap=small` vs current `mig=1g`). need to run label normalization.
infra-elyse: running label normalization: `kubectl label nodes -l legacy-mig=small mig=1g --overwrite` — doing in canary of 5 nodes first.
Priya S: good. also create alert suppression for the noisy placement-alert while we stabilize.
incident-bot: severity escalated to Sev2 by oncall-ron due to customer impact and needing infra changes.
Diego M: after label normalization and node additions, scheduler placed most pods. queue 650 -> 180 over 18m. tail latency down to ~1.2s.
QA-nate: running quick regression: no evicted high-priority jobs observed. some slowdown in batch job completion but acceptable.
infra-elyse: follow-up immediate actions: 1) add autoscaler fallback to alternate SKU when placement failures exceed 5 events in 10m, 2) implement nightly defrag job that consolidates 1g slices to reduce fragmentation, 3) add placement mismatch metric and alert, 4) document migration plan for legacy node labels.
Priya S: file incident ticket and assign RCAs: Diego to own scheduler fallback review, infra-elyse to own autoscaler template escalation, cs-maya to track customer comms.
cs-maya: sent updated note to customers, they acknowledged and asked for post-incident report.
oncall-ron: putting channel in monitoring mode for 45m. please escalate any regression. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked under control by oncall-ron.
